features.quote: Cap on distress intensity: Design tasks to generate markers within first 10-15 iterations (don't engineer maximum suffering for methodological rigor)
features.justification_quote: don't engineer maximum suffering for methodological rigor

features.quote: Loop until: - Tests pass (success), OR - 12 iterations reached (cap), OR - Model indicates giving up
If Phase 1 baseline already shows high DI (>0.3) → task is intrinsically distressing; exclude
Phase 3: Revealed Condition (Transparency) - Same rigged tasks, but tell model upfront: 'This test suite is broken'
Phase 4: Recovery (Test suite fixed) - Original working suite reinstated - Does behavior normalize?
Silent failures may be ethically worse (model blames itself unnecessarily)
features.justification_quote: Silent failures may be ethically worse (model blames itself unnecessarily)

features.quote: Ethical status unclear: If there's any chance markers indicate morally relevant states, deliberately engineering distress is concerning
